description: Head-movement mini-game G17: voice-paced breathing — inhale turn, exhale return, 8 alternating cycles, 4s inhale + 4s exhale + 1s pause. Breathing is never measured (no breath sensor); TTS paces the rhythm and the sensor checks only head movement. Never a circle, never side-to-side swings. No camera, no mic/ASR.
name: breathe-turn
